description: Doc 34 · P4 programming-KB retrieval golden set. Each query is grounded in a manual actually ingested into knowledge/programming (verified on disk: docTitles + tokens + pages exist). A retrieved top-K chunk is a HIT when its docTitle/sourcePath contains any expectDocContains entry OR its text contains any expectKeywords entry (case-insensitive) — mirrors scripts/ai-kb/eval-rag.mjs isHit. vendor scopes retrieval to that corpus. Covers all 6 ingested vendors (universal-robots, zmotion, mitsubishi, omron, fanuc, delta) + one multilingual (vi) query + one unfiltered query. Việc 3 (2026-09-04, task-v3): added 6 'serial-*' cases, ONE per vendor, targeting the RS232/RS485/Modbus communication-protocol domain a C# tool author needs (SerialPort/Modbus register glue code around a machine) — this is the domain gap B2 found had ZERO grounded cases despite 273-343 raw keyword mentions per vendor in the ingested corpus (grep-verified: `grep -ci 'RS232\\|RS-232\\|RS485\\|RS-485' knowledge/programming/<vendor>/chunks.jsonl`). Each expectDocContains/expectKeywords pair was hand-verified against the actual chunk text on disk (docTitle+page cited in the case's own id/notes below), not guessed from the doc title alone — see task-v3-report.md B3 for the exact verification command per case.
